label: Exploratory; not a test of H1-H10. Seen creators only. Model-coded voice labels, not checked by a person; agreement, never accuracy.
agnosticism: No measure in this study can tell whether a non-human source speaks; every measure describes the speech in these recordings and how the creators present it.
reading: told apart from register in these data (on these checks only); some rows' readings are not printed for privacy
reading_path: R0 A (1.79 SD, 90% 1.41 to 2.16, 34 creators); R3 register-matched A (1.61, 1.17 to 2.05); F1 AUC estimators agree (beyond/beyond before r3-P30's cap, undetermined/undetermined after); K-F1 D not printed (the row's count is banded)
auc_ladder: pooled within-creator AUC: F0 0.52, F1 0.73, F1c 0.77, F2 0.73; every rung at most undetermined under r3-P30 (no method holds below 71 creators); the median estimator and the quantiles over creators are not printed (D67; the lead's step-1 decision 18)
interval: drop, benchmark and D rows: r3-P30's choice for C_standardised; AUC: creator bootstrap 90% (prespec) with r3-P30's cap
departures: R3 without H4's form minimum (prespec named none): 44 creators against R0's 34
R1 class counts from transcript tokens by r3-P01's class rule; class B under 5 creators
The median AUC estimator is computed but not printed (privacy, D67; the lead's step-1 decision 18); no reading changes.
not_run: label run-to-run ceiling at creator level
not_stored: punctuation-stripped voice labels at unit level: not found among labels/seen instruments; reliability folders not opened

release_d67.dropped: median of creator AUCs with its interval; 10th, 50th and 90th percentiles over creators (CSV cells, README table, figure)
release_d67.kept: pooled within-creator AUC with interval; creator-equal mean; every reading
